risk_controls: Risk a fixed small fraction of capital per trade; size from stop distance.
Do not chase a vertical candle or breakout without volume confirmation.
Move to breakeven only after the setup has materially moved in your favour; do not widen stops.
If market regime is RISK-OFF, require stronger confirmation for longs.
If data is stale/missing, return WAIT rather than inventing a signal.
disclaimer: Decision-support only; not financial advice. Targets are rule-based estimates, not predictions.
